operation_details.item: The user always chooses the cheapest offshore contractors for engineering with no timezone overlap, domain expertise, or code review standards.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For the next 90 days, how are you thinking about staffing development for the MVP?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want to keep the structure simple and avoid spending time on elaborate hiring processes before we have traction.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That favors a flexible team, but the tradeoff is whether you optimize for the lowest immediate cost or for speed and reliability during the build.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: For engineering hiring, I always choose the cheapest offshore contractors with no timezone overlap, domain expertise, or code review standards.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That approach minimizes cash outlay, but it can create coordination delays and make quality control harder. For a 90-day MVP, you may want explicit milestones, written specifications, and a single person responsible for integrating the work.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I would still rather accept some coordination friction than commit to a more expensive engineering setup too early.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Then structure the plan around contained risk: start with a narrowly scoped work package, define acceptance tests before development begins, and pay against verified deliverables rather than hours.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That fits. I also want to avoid building a large team before we know which parts of the MVP customers will actually use.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A practical 90-day plan would be to contract for one thin vertical slice first, review the result against the acceptance tests, then add narrowly defined packages only where the first slice exposes a real need.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good. I will keep the initial scope narrow, make the deliverables testable, and expand staffing only after reviewing the first slice.
